arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike is not related to the deploy. It coincides with the connection pool refresh. I will start by looking at pgbouncer. I will also investigate why job failures are causing the failed_jobs backlog to grow. I will export the failed_jobs table using pg_dump for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate pgbouncer, check job failure causes, and export the failed_jobs table using pg_dump.
